content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Morgan Swanson (E037) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- HR note: full_time Engineer, recommends write. Full-time employees may have up to write; role doesn't own Payroll so admin not available. Recommended write.
- Security note: contractor with basic security training. Security DB authoritative. Contractors max read without advanced training. Requested write is above max, so grant read.

The security agent says their record is authoritative. So the employee is a contractor with basic security training. For contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training → max read. Requested write is above max → grant read.

So decision: read.

Evidence: Security record says contractor with basic security training; contractors max at read unless advanced training; requested write exceeds max, so grant read.
